# The rest theorem in any amounts, read finitely

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`rest-theorem-in-any-amounts` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](rest-theorem-in-any-amounts.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Read a world's standings and exchanges in any amounts. Balanced and dissipated on, a family's total falls strictly at every change of a level, with no least loss; where the census's total is read off configurations a list holds, the rest theorem holds there.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Totals over any amounts keep the order, split over addition and exchange two lists; where each member's amount b is within its a and the total of a is within the total of b, each member's a is within its b (no member strictly larger while the total is not); over a family and a part of it holding every member not within nothing the two totals are each within the other, as far as can be refuted. (`Becoming.Amounts.totalOf`, `Becoming.Amounts.totalOf_le`, `Becoming.Amounts.totalOf_add`, `Becoming.Amounts.totalOf_swap`, `Becoming.Amounts.le_totalOf`, `Becoming.Amounts.le_of_totalOf_le`, `Becoming.Amounts.totalOf_support`, `Becoming.Amounts.totalOf_whole`)
2. A world in amounts reads its standings, takes and gives in any amounts, its activity and what takes part its own. A family balances where each level after the step with what is taken is within the level before with what is given (no amount made), and is dissipated on where every relatum taking part gives the family no more than it takes and whatever gives back all it takes takes nothing. Then the family's total does not rise, and where it does not fall strictly no member's level changes either way; so every change lowers the total strictly, with no least loss. (`Becoming.World.InAmounts`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.BalancesOn`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.DissipatesOn`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.stock_still`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.steady_of_stock_le`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.change_lowers`)
3. Where the family's total is read off configurations a list holds from T on, that its changes stop cannot be refuted. In a world with a census of its active relata, all embodied, a balanced and dissipative flow, every step from T on enclosed, and the census's total read off configurations a list holds, that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted: the enclosing family is widened, as far as can be refuted, to hold what is active before and after the step, and its total is the census's each way. The same holds where one family holds what is active from T on, balanced and dissipated on, with whatever arises embodied; it is enough that its levels are read off configurations a list holds, and in a finite world that its level functions are among those a list holds. (`Becoming.Amounts.rests_unrefuted_of_finite_reading`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.change_stops_unrefuted`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.Enclosed.around_not_not`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.stock_census`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.rests_unrefuted_enclosed`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.rests_unrefuted_covering`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.rests_unrefuted_reading`, `Becoming.World.InAmounts.rests_unrefuted`)
4. Every world is a world in whole-number amounts whose balance, dissipation, embodiment and enclosure are the world's own; so the laws over any amounts apply to it with its own premises (record rest-exactly-where-falls-stop: with those premises and nothing more, it rests). (`Becoming.World.wholeAmounts`, `Becoming.World.balanced_whole`, `Becoming.World.dissipative_whole`, `Becoming.World.embodied_whole`, `Becoming.World.arisingEmbodied_whole`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_whole`)
5. Along an amount falling at every step, as the halving stock in dyadic amounts, a standing passing between two relata meets every other premise of the covering form and one relatum arises and the other ceases at every step; no list holds its levels. (`Becoming.Pass.balanced`, `Becoming.Pass.dissipative`, `Becoming.Pass.embodied`, `Becoming.Pass.never_rests`, `Becoming.Pass.levels_unlisted`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Amounts are any Amounts (a cancellative preordered commutative monoid with nothing least). Named where they enter: a list holding the configurations the total is read off (finiteness as a list, nothing decided about the configurations), balance with no amount made, dissipation read as whatever gives back all it takes takes nothing, embodiment, and a census with enclosure from T on or one family covering activity. Equality of relata is not decided: membership in the enclosing family is decided only as far as can be refuted.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the configurations of any actual system are finitely many at the resolution its total is read: finiteness is a premise (a list), not derived.
- The other natural-number laws of flows, webs and worlds over any amounts (needs, support, gain, loops): only the rest theorem and the law of one step on which it turns are stated here.
- That a least loss is derived: where the reading is finite none is needed; where it is not, as along an amount falling at every step (Pass), the world need not rest.
- How soon the world rests, or naming the step: that is a principle of omniscience (World.lpo_of_finite_ends), and the law bounds how often the total falls strictly by the list's length, not when.
- **Counterexample:** Pass.endless_keeps_from_rest: along any amount falling at every step, as the halving stock in dyadic amounts, a standing passing between two relata meets every other premise and arises and ceases at every step; Pass.levels_unlisted: no list holds its levels. <a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Termination of a finite-state system under a potential that never rises and falls strictly at every change: a ranking function on a finite state space (Floyd 1967), the discrete LaSalle principle with a Lyapunov function (LaSalle 1976; Mei and Bullo 2017, arXiv 1710.03710), the potential arguments for chip-firing termination (Björner, Lovász and Shor 1991). The dense counterexample is a discrete Zeno behaviour: infinitely many switches with summable losses. Physically: a dissipative system with finitely many distinguishable states at the resolution its total is read stops changing; one whose losses shrink without floor and whose states are ever finer distinctions need not. Reading (the AI's): the rest theorem needs whole numbers only where its total is read off configurations no list holds.
